faults.what: Caption displays 'Jones Gillray' instead of the historical British caricaturist 'James Gillray'.
The narrator pronounces the cartoonist's first name as 'Jones' or 'Jomes' instead of 'James'.
faults.fix: Re-record or correct audio pronunciation to 'James Gillray'.

faults.what: Narration mentions Napoleon's own guards ('Napoleon ke apne guards'), but the visual displays British redcoat guards in bearskin caps marching through London streets.
faults.fix: Replace imagery with historically accurate French Imperial Guards (Garde Impériale) in dark blue uniforms.

faults.what: Napoleon is shown standing flanked by guards dressed in British redcoat uniforms rather than French guards.
faults.fix: Use artwork or imagery showing Napoleon flanked by tall French Grenadiers of the Imperial Guard.

faults.what: The horse and rider show noticeable AI generation ghosting and transparent artifacting around the horse's flank and legs.
faults.fix: Replace or clean up the AI generation artifact on the horse in the opening shot.

faults.what: The subtitle 'Us dost ko bhejo...' lingers over the final channel subscription end card.
faults.fix: Clear the subtitle text when transitioning to the channel outro screen.

strongest: The opening 3 seconds immediately shatter a universal historical misconception with a punchy hook and dramatic visual.
weakest: Depicting Napoleon's personal guard as British redcoats undermines the historical credibility of the video.
